claims.nodeLabel: Council Bluffs, Iowa molten metal fall, 17 December 1977
claims.sourceText: Bud Appleby, 'Chunk of Molten Metal Found in Bluffs Has Residents Puzzled', Des Moines Register, 26 January 1978, cited in Sol Briefing No. 3
claims.text: Materials analyses in the weeks after the incident found the metal consisted of high-carbon steel and slag.

title: Chunk of Molten Metal Found in Bluffs Has Residents Puzzled
